summary: Keep work-start diagnostics private and preserve clean Git state

delivery.outcome: Publish the permanent NP-012 fix: best-effort diagnostic storage must preserve a clean governed Git tree, reject unsafe sinks and maintain structured fail-closed output.
nonGoals: No protected runtime, registry, CI requirement or approval bypass
No standalone new logging service or automatic adopter edits

architecture.decision: Keep the canonical HOME helper in new-project. Use only actual Git-ignored untracked operational receipts with descriptor-bound no-follow traversal, private permissions, nonblocking locking and bounded diagnostics. Missing or unsupported secure APIs return the same structured refusal without writing a log. Reuse the qualified V2; publish release projections atomically with the material fix.
architecture.rollback: Keep prior immutable adopter pins; revert through independent protected delivery. Preserve original diagnostic logs and never move existing tags.

validation.evidence: Actual CLI failures, unknown workstream, ignored/tracked sink checks, symlink/hardlink/private modes, bounded append and unsupported API negative control.
Native scope/architecture/budget plus immutable release parity and installed package contracts.

commands: Declared Goal immutable publication from reviewed main
validation.evidence: Fresh required Linux/Windows/OneDev and authentic protected exact-head approval/merge before adoption.
